title: Login
user_story: As a registered user, I want to log into the application using my registered email and password so that I can access my account.

title: Payment
user_story: As a customer, I want to pay for my order using a credit card so that I can complete my purchase securely.

title: Registration
user_story: As a new visitor, I want to create an account with my name, email and password so that I can use the application.

title: Search
user_story: As a shopper, I want to search for products using keywords and filter the results by price so that I can find items quickly.

title: Shopping cart
user_story: As a customer, I want to add items to my shopping cart and update their quantity so that I can buy several products together.

title: Profile
user_story: As a logged-in user, I want to update my name, phone number and profile picture so that my information stays current.

title: Notifications
user_story: As a member, I want to receive an email notification when my order ships and be able to turn notifications off so that I stay informed without being disturbed.

title: Data management
user_story: As an admin, I want to create, edit and delete employee records so that the employee data stays accurate.

title: Password reset
user_story: As an account holder, I want to reset my forgotten password using an email link so that I can regain access to my account.

title: Vague story (quality demo)
user_story: The system should handle login properly and be fast, etc.
